# A value is STR(x, 25, 12) and VARTYPE; an error is its number and message.

[const]
  MOD(5,3)                         -> 2.000000000000 (N)   ; control
  MOD(5,0)                         raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.
  MOD(0,0)                         raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.
  MOD(-5,0)                        raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.
  MOD(5.5,0)                       raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.
  MOD(5,0.0)                       raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.
  MOD(5,-0)                        raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; negative zero, if the literal is one
  MOD(5,1E-300)                    -> 0.000000000000 (N)   ; tiny but not zero
  5 % 0                            raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; the operator form
  SQRT(4)                          -> 2.000000000000 (N)   ; control
  SQRT(-1)                         raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.
  SQRT(-0.5)                       raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.
  SQRT(-1E-300)                    raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; tiny negative
  SQRT(-0)                         -> 0.000000000000 (N)   ; negative zero: -0 < 0 is false
  ATN2(SQRT(-0),-1)                -> 3.141592653590 (N)   ; pi if SQRT(-0) is +0, -pi if -0
  ATN2(-0,-1)                      -> 3.141592653590 (N)   ; control for the line above
  1/0                              -> ************************* (N)   ; provenance for ADR-50, which kept CodeBase's 0
  0/0                              -> ************************* (N)   ; provenance for ADR-50

[null]
  MOD(.NULL.,3)                    -> .NULL. (L)
  MOD(5,.NULL.)                    -> .NULL. (L)
  MOD(.NULL.,0)                    -> .NULL. (L)   ; null dividend, zero divisor
  SQRT(.NULL.)                     -> .NULL. (L)

[guard]
  IIF(.T., 1, SQRT(-1))            -> 1.000000000000 (N)   ; unselected branch raises?
  IIF(.F., SQRT(-1), 1)            -> 1.000000000000 (N)   ; unselected branch raises?
  IIF(.T., SQRT(-1), 1)            raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; selected branch
  IIF(.F., 1, MOD(5,0))            raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; selected branch
  .F. AND SQRT(-1) > 0             -> .F. (L)   ; AND short-circuits?
  SQRT(-1) > 0 AND .F.             raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; left operand raises first?
  .T. OR SQRT(-1) > 0              -> .T. (L)   ; OR short-circuits?
  SQRT(-1) > 0 OR .T.              raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; left operand raises first?
  .T. AND MOD(5,0) = 0             raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; AND evaluates the right operand
  NOT (.F. AND SQRT(-1) > 0)       -> .T. (L)   ; short-circuit under NOT
  MIN(1, SQRT(-1))                 raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; no laziness expected

[records]
# K_NUM by record: 1: 4  2: -4  3: 0  4: .NULL.  5: 9
  SQRT(K_NUM)                      -> 2.000000000000 (N)   ; record 1
  MOD(10,K_NUM)                    -> 2.000000000000 (N)   ; record 1
  SQRT(K_NUM)                      raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative.   ; record 2
  MOD(10,K_NUM)                    -> -2.000000000000 (N)   ; record 2
  SQRT(K_NUM)                      -> 0.000000000000 (N)   ; record 3
  MOD(10,K_NUM)                    raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; record 3
  SQRT(K_NUM)                      -> .NULL. (N)   ; record 4
  MOD(10,K_NUM)                    -> .NULL. (N)   ; record 4
  SQRT(K_NUM)                      -> 3.000000000000 (N)   ; record 5
  MOD(10,K_NUM)                    -> 1.000000000000 (N)   ; record 5

[count]
  SQRT(K_NUM) > 1                          raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative. at record 2
  MOD(10,K_NUM) = 0                        raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0. at record 3
  K_NUM >= 0 AND SQRT(K_NUM) > 1           -> 2
  K_NUM <> 0 AND MOD(10,K_NUM) = 0         -> 0
  IIF(K_NUM < 0, 0, SQRT(K_NUM)) > 1       -> 2

[index]
  T_SQRT   SQRT(K_NUM)                      raises 61 SQRT() argument cannot be negative. at record 2; tag absent
  T_MOD    MOD(10,K_NUM)                    raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0. at record 3; tag absent
  T_GUARD  IIF(K_NUM < 0, 0, SQRT(K_NUM))   built; tag present

[null-band]
# N_ N(8,2), I_ I, C_ C(10), L_ L -- all .NULL.
  ABS(N_)                          -> .NULL. (N)
  INT(N_)                          -> .NULL. (N)
  ROUND(N_,2)                      -> .NULL. (N)
  ROUND(5.25,I_)                   -> .NULL. (N)   ; null places
  MOD(N_,3)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MOD(5,N_)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MOD(N_,0)                        raises 1307 Cannot divide by 0.   ; null dividend, zero divisor
  MIN(N_,1)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MIN(1,N_)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MIN(1,2,N_)                      -> .NULL. (N)   ; variadic, null last
  MAX(N_,1)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MAX(1,N_)                        -> .NULL. (N)
  MIN(C_,'a')                      -> .NULL. (C)   ; the string overload
  MAX('a',C_)                      -> .NULL. (C)   ; the string overload
  SQRT(N_)                         -> .NULL. (N)
  SIGN(N_)                         -> .NULL. (N)
  LEN(C_)                          -> .NULL. (N)
  AT(C_,'abc')                     -> .NULL. (N)
  AT('a',C_)                       -> .NULL. (N)
  AT('a','abc',I_)                 -> .NULL. (N)   ; null occurrence
  ASC(C_)                          -> .NULL. (N)
  LOWER(C_)                        -> .NULL. (C)
  REPLICATE(C_,2)                  -> .NULL. (C)
  REPLICATE('a',I_)                -> .NULL. (C)   ; null count
  IIF(L_,1,2)                      -> 2.000000000000 (N)   ; control: a null condition
  ABS(N_) = 0                      -> .NULL. (L)   ; the wrong-record-set case: .NULL. or .F.?
